scenes.voiceover: Spills and accidents stay on the surface, not in the mattress.

scenes.voiceover: Four and a half stars isn't luck at this many reviews — it's consistency.

scenes.visual_prompt: Product listing screen showing price and add-to-cart button, then fade to made bed

caption:
106,545 people rated this mattress protector. 4.5 stars.

A twin mattress protector doesn't get flashy reviews. People buy it, put it on the bed, and forget about it — which is exactly the point. It's built for a deep pocket fit up to 15 inches, so it works with thicker mattresses and toppers without slipping off.

It's waterproof, so spills, sweat, and accidents stay off the actual mattress instead of soaking in. At 4.5 stars across 106,545 reviews, that volume of consistent rating is hard to fake — this is a product that does its one job reliably for most people who buy it.

Your mattress stays protected without you thinking about it again, for $12.99.
